remarks: Great house in the Fair Oaks Ranch community.  High ceilings as you enter the formal living room,  2,738 square feet of living space,  5 bedrooms and 3 baths. There's a bedroom downstairs and a full bathroom next to it. The spacious kitchen has a large island, lots of counter space and cabinets, next to it is the living room area.  Upstairs,  there are 4 bedrooms. The primary bedroom has a large primary bathroom. It also has an opening to the adjacent bedroom for easy access. The backyard is easy to maintain.  Includes a 3-car garage and a laundry room.
